checks.name: Automatic recovery is atomic, source-relative and separate from explicit project save
Queued save/clear operations preserve invocation order
Recovery rejects unregistered media paths and keeps the prior snapshot
Second instance exits without overwriting the active process recovery
New Electron process offers real UI restore, reauthorizes media, and preserves mask/easing
Real UTF-8 SRT file sorts times and round-trips multiline Chinese/emoji
SRT rejects ambiguous blank paragraphs without changing project or output
Canceled and empty subtitle exports do not write files; removed historical source folders do not block SRT
Missing-source recovery restores an editable offline placeholder with stable ID and all mask/easing data
Offline recovery survives automatic saving and another real process restart without losing source/edit records
Corrupt recovery can be explicitly ignored; automatic saving resumes
Successful UI save clears pending recovery and cancels its debounce
